title: Bridge of Evidence
cast_lock: adult technical educator in their mid 30s, shoulder-length dark hair, rust cardigan over a plain white top
location_lock: modest home-office project room with a cork decision board, wood desk, window and warm practical lamp
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: six-panel vertical social-video storyboard reference for ST-024 Bridge of Evidence
Primary request: create ONE polished contact-sheet image containing exactly six clearly separated sequential photorealistic frames of the same fictional adult in the same environment. It should feel like candid frames captured from a real phone-shot Instagram Reel or YouTube Short while remaining an original clean-room scene.
Subject continuity: fictional non-identifiable adult technical educator in their mid 30s, shoulder-length dark hair, rust cardigan over a plain white top. Ordinary natural face, realistic skin texture, restrained expression; same person, hair and wardrobe in all six panels.
Scene continuity: modest home-office project room with a cork decision board, wood desk, window and warm practical lamp. Same environment, props, time of day and left-to-right screen direction across all panels.
Persistent target: bounded conclusion. Trigger prop: bridge. Proof prop: source plank. Obstacle: one supporting plank is missing.
Six panels in reading order:
1 macro still: notices the bridge; show The bridge changes before the objective is secure. Emotional register: surprise.
2 wide still: locates the bounded conclusion; show The hero and persistent bounded conclusion share one scene; objective: connect a claim to a conclusion. Emotional register: orientation.
3 medium still: adds dated sources and labels the remaining gap; show The hero adds dated sources and labels the remaining gap; the same bounded conclusion changes state on screen. Emotional register: concern.
4 close still: sees the bounded conclusion blocked; show The bounded conclusion is visibly blocked by one supporting plank is missing; consequence: the conclusion cannot bear weight. Emotional register: agency.
5 diagram still: checks the source plank; show The changed bounded conclusion remains visible while the source plank is isolated. Emotional register: confidence-with-caution.
6 medium still: returns the resolved target to the viewer; show The resolved bounded conclusion stays visible while the sequence returns to A-roll: the bridge carries only the supported claim. Emotional register: relief.
Final panel truth boundary: visually preserve room for a later editable limitation overlay meaning 'More sources do not automatically remove bias.', but render no words.
Style/medium: realistic phone-native documentary/editorial frame capture, vertical social video, modest sharpening, slight shadow noise, natural highlight rolloff, subtle handheld imperfection, no cinematic LUT and no beauty retouching.
Composition: contact sheet with six equal portrait-oriented cells in a 2-column by 3-row grid with clean neutral gutters. No titles or captions inside cells. Keep the face, hands, persistent target, trigger, obstacle and proof visible and internally consistent.
Lighting/mood: motivated soft window light plus a believable practical source; natural mixed light; emotional progression from recognition/concern to agency and cautious relief.
Constraints: exactly six panels; same fictional adult, wardrobe, environment and prop identities; realistic hands/anatomy; blank or abstract paper/screen surfaces for later editable overlays; no generated text; no logos; no watermark; no platform UI.
Avoid: celebrity or creator likeness, distinctive source composition, influencer reaction face, branded office or software UI, luxury styling, neon tech lighting, cinematic anamorphic effects, plastic skin, warped hands, extra fingers, duplicated/missing props, identity drift, wardrobe changes, impossible reflections, fake metrics, testimonial imagery, unsupported success symbolism, copied creator caption or CTA.
